j4q.shaders

Class Texture

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.shaders.Texture
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Text

    public class Texture
extends java.lang.Object
    Class for managing OpenGL ES textures, including loading from assets and resources, uploading to GPU, and binding to texture units.
